title: BC Friday Tips #61 Check AppSource App Update History
summary: When evaluating AppSource apps for Business Central, check the last updated date before installing. Apps without recent updates risk containing bugs or failing to use current AL features since the platform changes with each release.
key_points: Review the last updated date of AppSource apps before installation
Outdated apps may contain bugs due to platform changes in recent releases
Older apps might not leverage newer AL features available in current versions
Long-lasting app updates without maintenance indicate potential compatibility risks
